result.instructions: EquationNews (方程式新闻) is a real-time crypto newswire: exchange listings and notices, price / open-interest moves, Korean exchanges, macro headlines and more, in Chinese and English. All times are UTC. Channels: main = EquationNews (方程式新闻); tradfi = Equation TradFi (方程式财经); binance = Binance Monitor (币安公告); korea = Korean Exchanges (韩所监控); pricechange = Price Moves (价格异动); oi = OI & Price Moves (OI价格异动); major = Big Moves (大幅波动); tier2 = Tier-2 Listings (二线上新); tier3 = Tier-3 Listings (三线上新); alpha = Binance Alpha (币安Alpha); cz = CZ & Yi He Watch (CZ&何一); earn = Earn Alerts (理财提醒). Use list_news for the latest stories (filter by channel, coin ticker or keyword; keyword search covers the last 30 days; page back with next_cursor). Use get_news for one story's full text in every language; it also returns `ai` when the story has an AI summary (exchange announcements) or an AI overview (background researched on the web, updated during the first 2 hours; status=pending means check back in a few minutes). AI content is for reference only and may contain errors. Cite stories with their url (https://eqn.news/<main|tradfi|monitor>/<no>). For push delivery instead of polling, use the WebSocket wss://api.eqn.news/public/ws or the RSS feed https://api.eqn.news/public/rss. Docs: https://eqn.news/api-docs#mcp
